real_boundaries: Native SkyRL TrajectoryID and BatchMetadata types
Native output validator in both ordinary and step-wise modes
Exact pinned Qwen tokenizer and native PromptDataset from the existing combined suite
Native inference-client payload and MCP 1.28.0 transport from the existing combined suite
batch_gates: Frozen train/dev rows, prompts, environment metadata, run and manifest identity
Complete repetition groups with unique immutable attempt IDs
Original sampled token IDs, masked tool observations and aligned log probabilities
Genuine zero reward is preserved; malformed samples are rejected
One durable batch claim; replay and reentry are rejected
Failed or cancelled siblings are awaited through cleanup, without replacement samples
No raw exception details in the native batch failure
limits: Synthetic Fleet and inference responses only; zero live Fleet requests or optimizer steps.
The internal generator is not yet wired to a public SkyRL RL launcher.
Real reward acquisition, weight synchronization, optimizer update and checkpoint recovery remain required.
Coverage is complete for the batch module, not the whole repository or every shared Miles branch.
